tagline: Local STIHL dealer, sales, service and advice
heroSubheading: We sell, service and advise on outdoor power equipment for your land and garden.
aboutHtml:
We're Gareth and Amie, owners of STIHL SHOP Hastings. We've lived in the Hawkes Bay for many years and take pride in serving our local community with quality outdoor power equipment. Whether you're a homeowner, contractor, farmer or business, we've got the gear.

We stock STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Honda, Ziegler & Brown, Billy Goat and others, plus genuine parts, oils, accessories and tools from Fiskars, Silky and Wolf Garten. Our fully equipped workshop handles sales, servicing and repair for all major brands.

Our team knows these products inside out. We give sound advice before you buy, friendly service when you're here, and reliable support after the sale. Come in and let us help you find the right gear for your land.
